summary: Aggregate a dataset to a coarser period and publish it as a new dataset
description: Loads a published dataset over a time range, reduces its steps within each period (e.g. daily to monthly means) with aggregate_period_start (plugins/processes/), which labels each period by its first day as stored datasets are, and publishes the result as a new GeoZarr dataset. Used by recipes in plugins/rasters/ so a dataset exists at the period other datasets are compared at, kept current as its input updates.

parameters.name: input_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published dataset to aggregate, e.g. era5land_relative_humidity_daily.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the dataset to publish; a recipe passes its template's own id.

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable carried through to the published dataset.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to aggregate to: week (ISO), month, season or year.

parameters.name: reducer
parameters.description: How the steps within a period are combined: mean, sum, min or max.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range of the input to aggregate, as [start, end] ISO-8601 dates. A recipe fills it with the input's coverage.
